alignments.note: Construct chain rendered attributively under rule 28; the construct noun stands before the rectum's word, so it takes the supplied determiner under rule 29 and heads on its own lexeme under rule 31. Nomen rectum rendered as the English head noun.
Nominal predicate of a verbless clause takes the construction-supplied copula under rule 20; the *a* is the noun's own under rule 15.
Preposition with its own suffix fused into the pronominal adverb *therein*, one unit headed on the preposition under rules 22 and 30.
Nominal predicate with the supplied copula and its own *a*.
The בְּ recast as the relational *of*.
Noun with its supplied *the* under rule 15.

review_notes: The alternative for s001/s002 would give the *A* to לָשׁוֹן as the English head noun; rule 29's attributive paragraph puts a supplied determiner on the word it stands before, which here is the construct noun's *gentle*.
